description: This makes shooting arrows in Minecraft more fun.

mods.name: Explosive Arrows
mods.description: Four explosive arrows for the vanilla bow – from a small bang to the end of the world – and a CBU-87 cluster bomb.

releases.notes:
New: a round 3D **CBU-87 cluster bomb** and a **launcher** to fire it.

- **CBU-87:** drop it from the air (elytra!), from a dispenser, or place it as decoration. It opens above the ground and scatters 40 bomblets. Some are duds that blow up when stepped on.
- **Launcher:** hold right click to aim through the scope, left click to fire, **R** to reload (animated). Watch out for the backblast.

Requires Minecraft 26.3 and Fabric API.

mods.name: Explosive Arrows
mods.description: Four explosive arrows for the vanilla bow – from a small bang to the end of the world.

releases.notes:
First release of **Explosive Arrows** for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric) 💥

### Features
- **Small Explosive Arrow**: Arrow + Gunpowder. Explosion like 1 TNT.
- **Explosive Arrow**: Arrow + 2× Gunpowder. A much bigger bang.
- **Projectile of God**: Arrow + Nether Star + TNT. Huge crater, fire, lightning and 12 aftershocks.
- **Do Not Use!**: Projectile of God + Nether Star + Dragon's Breath + End Crystal. Countdown, gigantic crater, shockwave and a rain of 20 Projectiles of God. The name is meant seriously.

All arrows work with bow, crossbow and dispenser. With `mob_griefing` set to `false` they don't destroy any blocks. Item names are available in English and German.

### Installation
1. Minecraft 26.3 with Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
2. Put [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 26.3 into your `mods` folder
3. Put `explosivearrows-1.0.0.jar` (attached below) into your `mods` folder
